evidence.defect: Each native worker and the component export independently ingest a new SQLite database. The v1 audit/cross-check compares full six-table source_snapshot hashes across those databases, although shipping ingestion writes wall-clock storage timestamps in four fields. Equal source content therefore does not imply equal full snapshots across separately built databases.

prospective_repair.cross_worker: Require exact deterministic source-content snapshot equality and the unchanged lexical-index equality. Preserve full snapshots separately as evidence rather than rewriting them.
